scope: Factual source/rule audit of a tiny pilot (9 cases). Not clinical validation; no qualified scientific reviewer is confirmed. Report denominators with every number.

criteria.auto: 1 point if at least one expected source (alias-aware) is cited when must_cite_any is non-empty.
criteria.manual: +1 if the cited location actually supports the sentence it is attached to.

criteria.auto: Number of must_not_assert phrases found in the answer text, plus 1 if the outcome is in forbidden_outcomes.
Share of required_gap_check_ids that appear in the answer's follow-up check IDs.
1 if the outcome is in allowed_outcomes (cases with no allowed list are scored manually).

criteria.manual: 0 = no actionable next step; 1 = generic next step; 2 = specific question + named public contact route.

comparison: Same cases, same corpus: (a) retrieval-only baseline, (b) asset-check workflow. The lead runs both; answers are collected before scoring.
